description_en: Disables the Orca (Redis-compatible) feature for a PolarDB cluster
kebab_example: aliyun polardb disable-db-cluster-orca --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --clean-data Enable --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisableDBClusterOrca

parameters.description_en:

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to query the details of all clusters in a specific region, including cluster IDs.
